summary: Iteration 4 verified BOTH iteration-3 frontend fixes end-to-end via browser automation on a fresh profile. (1) FAST EMPTY STATE: seeding a new uid in localStorage and opening /plan now shows 'Ton plan sur-mesure' + 'Générer mon plan' in 1.4s (was 2 min in iter 3) — plan.tsx load() catch block correctly short-circuits on '404:' errors (line 50-54). (2) REFRESHED BANNER AFTER MANUAL GENERATE: tapping 'Générer mon plan' triggered the correct loading UI ('L'IA prépare ta semaine…' + '28 repas équilibrés, variés et de saison'), NO red error banner during the ~70s wait, and the green 'Nouveau plan généré pour cette semaine ✨' banner (testID plan-refreshed-banner) appeared alongside the rendered 7-day plan and correctly auto-dismissed after 6s (line 117-118). (3) NO REGRESSIONS: plan-screen rendered with plan-day-0 (7 day chips), plan-meal-breakfast (Porridge estival aux myrtilles / Salade de pâtes au poulet et poivrons), plan-regenerate button all present. Backend UNCHANGED per spec — no backend testing performed this iteration.
action_items: Both iter-3 regressions are FIXED. No further action required on plan.tsx for this feature.
OPTIONAL long-term: consider migrating POST /mealplan/generate to a background-task pattern (202 + poll) to eliminate the client-side 55s abort + polling loop dance — see iter-3 report for context.
OPTIONAL DRY: extract the duplicated 24×5s polling loop shared by load() and generate() into a reusable hook usePollForFreshPlan(uid, startedIso).
critical_code_review_comments: plan.tsx load() 404 short-circuit uses `e.message.startsWith('404:')` — works because api.ts throws Error(`${status}: ${body}`). Consider a typed ApiError class long-term for cleaner status filtering (already noted in iter 3).
plan.tsx now has consistent refreshedBanner behaviour across load() and generate() polling-success branches — both call setRefreshedBanner(true) + 6s timeout. ✅
Non-blocking: console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' appears on load — from a nested RN dependency; not user-visible.
